description: rewind/fork CLI guard compares libgit2 find_remote(url) output (insteadOf rewrites APPLIED, so SSH-proxy form) against canonical run origin; on machines with url.*.insteadOf proxies the comparison can never match, blocking rewind/fork entirely. Workaround: run with empty HOME (no global gitconfig) + remote.origin.url temporarily set to canonical + copied .fabro auth. Fix: read remote.origin.url from raw config (no rewrite) or canonicalize both sides.

content: Branch model (since 2026-08-21): main = pure upstream mirror (tracks upstream/main, ff-only, never commit locally; sync: git fetch upstream && git push origin upstream/main:main && git branch -f main upstream/main — note the last step, pushing remote main does not move local main). denkhaus = personal integration branch on origin, default checkout for all work (seeds/mulch/.fabro); workflow runs clone branch denkhaus. fix/*,feat/* = contribution branches off upstream/main for PRs to fabro-sh/fabro. Update flow: fetch upstream, replay personal commits via cherry-pick onto new upstream base (proven 2026-08-21: 13 commits clean). Upstream very active (~4600 commits/nightly bump).

description: GitHub branch protection: a required status check context whose name matches a check run already reported by an app (e.g. Actions lab-check) auto-resolves to that app_id on every protection PUT, even after delete+recreate with plain string contexts. App-pinned required checks are only satisfiable by that app's check runs — commit statuses (statuses API) never count.
resolution: Use a context name with no app history (lab-check-local) and post a commit status locally from run_workflow.nu after terminal success (variant B, fabro-ab2c)

description: Verifying 'is X merged into Y' with a compound shell line (git branch -r --contains ... | head -3 || git merge-base ... && echo merged) lies: head's exit 0 masks git's failure and shell precedence turns the wrong branch into a success message. Produced a false 'auto-merge landed' confirmation during the 01M11P68SHF postmortem.
resolution: Always run merge-detection as a SINGLE git command and check $? explicitly; never let a pipe or compound chain answer an integration question.

name: Push/PR discipline: run-start danger window, JSONL dedupe, mergeable verify
description: Push/PR discipline: run-start danger window, JSONL dedupe, mergeable verify
gh without --repo targets fabro-sh/fabro, not origin denkhaus/fabro — PR numbers collide across the two repos
resolution: Pass --repo denkhaus/fabro on EVERY gh call in this checkout (list, view, checks, merge). Before trusting any gh output, confirm the resolved default with gh repo view. Symptom class: green checks or 'already merged' for a PR that is actually OPEN on origin — PR numbers are per-repo (#427 = live lane PR on denkhaus/fabro, 2026-05 merge on fabro-sh/fabro). Evidence 2026-10-17: wrong PR's checks read first, then gh pr merge against the wrong repo (harmless only because that one was already merged).

description: stale /tmp commit-message file reused by commit -F
resolution: amend before push; write+verify+commit+rm as one ceremony

content: Before git commit after a bulk stage: derive the staging set from the change itself (git diff --name-only) or verify the staged list against the expected path prefixes — git add -A sweeps strays and sibling work in shared checkouts.
